title: WP-BLD-A: freeze badf-build capability contract (G07 execution under a Governed Work Package; DESIGNED, thin router, no second gate)
objective: Freeze the badf-build contract as a declarative router: badf-build executes exactly one authorized Governed Work Package inside its exact scope, baseline, budget and stop contract; badf-implementation-plan decides HOW work is decomposed (IMP-I15: it cannot execute), badf-git governs repository integration, G08 verifies independently, the canonical gate evaluates G07 evidence, and authority permits lifecycle transitions. Adapts Matt Pocock's implement/tdd discipline (bounded source contract, governed TDD at durable seams, red before green, continuous typecheck/test, full verification at finish) and obra/superpowers' execution pipeline (isolation, fresh-context units, review loops, recovery ledger, verification before completion) while REJECTING their authority semantics (ticket as authority, agent ruling as authority, autonomous scope expansion, branch finish as merge permission, self-review as G08 assurance). BLD-I01..I18 frozen; no runtime, no validator, no schema, no lifecycle change.
business_value: Every coding agent can build; BADF needs a build that cannot exceed its authorization: scope contained to planned surfaces, red-before-green evidence where a seam exists, fresh verification before any completion claim, delegation that only narrows authority, budget and stop conditions that dominate. The freeze makes that contract the thing later rungs implement and shadow, instead of an opinion.
